owner_question: Which channels created enquiries in the last 30 days: calls, missed calls, WhatsApp, website forms, ads, referrals, Google Business Profile or reactivation lists?
safe_non_patient_evidence: Channel names, public landing pages, call-count totals, anonymized source tags, owner notes
unsafe_do_not_send: Patient names, phone numbers, treatment history, medical reports, embryo/lab details, call recordings, WhatsApp exports with identifiers
decision_use: Shows where enquiry leakage may need owner review before more ad, CRM or agency spend
claim_boundary: Synthetic questionnaire only; no real clinic, patient, appointment, revenue, ranking, DPDP compliance or medical outcome claim

owner_question: Who owns first response, backup response and unresolved follow-up for each route?
safe_non_patient_evidence: Role names, shift coverage, SLA target, anonymized owner initials or placeholder owner IDs
unsafe_do_not_send: Staff personal phone exports, patient chats, HR records, credentials, payroll data
claim_boundary: Readiness template only; requires clinic and qualified adviser review before operational use

owner_question: Which enquiries must stop automation and move to qualified human review?
safe_non_patient_evidence: Category labels such as treatment question, medication question, finance question, emergency/urgent, privacy/consent question
unsafe_do_not_send: Clinical details, prescriptions, diagnoses, lab values, personal sensitive data
decision_use: Prevents unsafe bot/receptionist scripts from handling sensitive IVF questions
claim_boundary: Operational education only; not medical, legal, privacy, security or advertising advice

owner_question: Where is consent, notice, opt-out or script approval unclear?
safe_non_patient_evidence: Public notice URLs, approved template IDs, opt-out process notes, adviser-question list
unsafe_do_not_send: Patient consent records, ID documents, medical files, unredacted WhatsApp threads
decision_use: Creates the DPDP/adviser question queue before WhatsApp automation or reactivation campaigns
claim_boundary: No DPDP compliance claim; adviser questions only

owner_question: What evidence proves the next step happened and the enquiry is closed or escalated?
safe_non_patient_evidence: Anonymized status counts, timestamp buckets, closure reasons, owner sign-off fields
unsafe_do_not_send: Patient-identifiable appointment records, payment screenshots, report files, clinical notes
decision_use: Gives owners a weekly leakage ledger and safe handoff pack before platform changes
claim_boundary: Synthetic no-patient template; no appointment-growth, savings, revenue or ROI claim
